CatL_length_FALSE.zh: 调查拟合 length 对数尺度
CatL_length_FALSE.code:
plot_CatL(b, type = typ, exp_transform = ex, facet_ncol = 4, x_breaks = if (typ == "length") c(2000, 
    2010, 2015) else c(10, 30, 50), point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6, ylab = if (ex) "Survey index" else "Log survey index")
CatL_length_FALSE.note_zh: 点为观测对数，曲线为拟合的 Elog_index。
CatL_length_FALSE.note_en: Points are log observations; curves show fitted Elog_index.

CatL_length_TRUE.zh: 调查拟合 length 原尺度
CatL_length_TRUE.code:
plot_CatL(b, type = typ, exp_transform = ex, facet_ncol = 4, x_breaks = if (typ == "length") c(2000, 
    2010, 2015) else c(10, 30, 50), point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6, ylab = if (ex) "Survey index" else "Log survey index")
CatL_length_TRUE.note_zh: 原尺度曲线为 exp(Elog_index)，即对数正态中位数。
CatL_length_TRUE.note_en: Original-scale curves are lognormal medians, exp(Elog_index).

CatL_year_FALSE.zh: 调查拟合 year 对数尺度

CatL_year_FALSE.note_zh: 朱红色为观测对数，深蓝色为拟合的 Elog_index。
CatL_year_FALSE.note_en: Vermilion curves are log observations; navy curves show fitted Elog_index.

plot_abundance_N.code: do.call(fun, list(b, type = typ, se = TRUE, facet_ncol = 3, line_size = 0.6))
plot_abundance_N.note_zh: ALSCL 示例；A 表示年龄组，L 表示长度组。有可用标准误时显示近似 95% 区间。 总量图显示各组之和；分面图的纵轴按组调整。
plot_abundance_N.note_en: ALSCL example: A denotes age, L length. Approximate 95% intervals appear where standard errors are available. Totals sum across groups; faceted y axes adjust to each group.

recruitment.note_zh: 补充量对应最小年龄组；受设定的补充年龄和时间步长影响。
recruitment.note_en: Recruitment enters the youngest age class; its interpretation depends on recruitment age and time step.

SSB_Rec.note_zh: 横轴与补充量错开 1 个观测步长。这里只画散点，不拟合资源补充函数。
SSB_Rec.note_en: Recruitment is shifted by one observation step. This is a scatter plot, not a fitted stock recruitment curve.

VB.note_zh: 生长参数在本例中固定，区间退化为曲线；释放参数后区间才反映估计不确定性，不是个体长度分布。
VB.note_en: Growth is fixed in this example, so its interval collapses. With estimated growth, intervals reflect parameter uncertainty, not individual length variation.

pla.note_zh: 色值是长度组给定年龄的概率；不是增长转移矩阵 G。年龄标签为组序号。
pla.note_en: Cells are length-bin probabilities conditional on age, not the growth transition matrix G. Age labels are class indices.

F_ACL_year.code:
plot_fishing_mortality(fit, type = if (model == "ACL" && typ == "length") "age" else typ, se = TRUE, 
    facet_ncol = 4, line_size = 0.6)
F_ACL_year.note_zh: 年度示例的 F 为每年瞬时率；季度数据得到每季度率。不同模型的原生 F 维度不同。
F_ACL_year.note_en: F is an instantaneous rate per model step. Native F dimensions differ between the models.

F_ACL_age.code:
plot_fishing_mortality(fit, type = if (model == "ACL" && typ == "length") "age" else typ, se = TRUE, 
    facet_ncol = 4, line_size = 0.6)
F_ACL_age.note_zh: 年度示例的 F 为每年瞬时率；季度数据得到每季度率。不同模型的原生 F 维度不同。

F_ACL_length.code:
plot_fishing_mortality(fit, type = if (model == "ACL" && typ == "length") "age" else typ, se = TRUE, 
    facet_ncol = 4, line_size = 0.6)
F_ACL_length.note_zh: 当前 ACL 的 length 分支与 age 分支相同，仍是年龄曲线，不能作为长度别 F。
F_ACL_length.note_en: In this version, ACL length is an alias of age; the output is still age-specific F.

residuals_length.code:
plot_residuals(b, type = typ, facet_ncol = 4, x_breaks = if (typ == "length") c(2000, 2010, 
    2015) else c(10, 30, 50), line_size = 0.6)
residuals_length.note_zh: 观测对数减预测对数；未经标准差标准化。平滑线用于发现结构，不是显著性检验。
residuals_length.note_en: Observed minus fitted log index, without standardization. Smooth curves reveal structure, not significance.

residuals_year.note_en: Observed minus fitted log index, without standardization. Smooth curves reveal structure, not significance.

deviation_R_TRUE.code:
plot_deviance(b, type = typ, log = lg, se = TRUE, facet_ncol = 3, point_size = 1.2, line_size = 0.5) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2000, 2010, 2019), expand = expansion(mult = 0.04))
deviation_R_TRUE.note_zh: 对数过程偏差以 0 为参照。这不是似然偏差统计量。
deviation_R_TRUE.note_en: Log process deviations use zero as reference; these are not likelihood deviance statistics.

deviation_R_FALSE.code:
plot_deviance(b, type = typ, log = lg, se = TRUE, facet_ncol = 3, point_size = 1.2, line_size = 0.5) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2000, 2010, 2019), expand = expansion(mult = 0.04))
deviation_R_FALSE.note_zh: 指数转换后以 1 为参照，区间不对称。这不是原尺度残差。
deviation_R_FALSE.note_en: Exponentiated deviations use one as reference and asymmetric intervals; these are not original-scale residuals.

deviation_F_TRUE.code:

ridges.note_zh: 每期分别归一化；左为观测，右为拟合。不能由此读出总丰度趋势。需当前会话中的 obj。
ridges.note_en: Each period is normalized separately: observations left, fit right. This does not show total abundance trends. A live obj is required.

compare_ts.note_zh: 只比较共同输出与相同时间窗；自由纵轴不能直接比较不同量的振幅。
compare_ts.note_en: Compare common quantities over the same time window. Free y axes preclude amplitude comparisons across quantities.

compare_F.note_zh: ACL 纵轴是年龄，ALSCL 纵轴是长度；颜色可辅助观察，但两行不逐格对应。
compare_F.note_en: ACL uses age and ALSCL length on the vertical axis; cells do not correspond one to one.

compare_residuals.note_zh: 包括直方图、QQ 图、年度残差和长度组箱线图。年度误差棒是标准差，不是置信区间。
compare_residuals.note_en: Includes histograms, QQ plots, annual residuals and length-bin boxplots. Annual error bars represent SD, not confidence intervals.

compare_growth.code:
growth_display(plot_compare_growth(a, b, age_range = c(1, 15), ref_data = ref, ref_name = "Synthetic reference", 
    nls_start = list(Linf = 60, k = 0.2, t0 = 1/60)))
compare_growth.note_zh: 灰色参照曲线来自模拟 Age 与 Length；不代表论文实测生长。
compare_growth.note_en: The reference curve uses synthetic Age and Length data, not empirical measurements from the paper.

compare_CatL.code: plot_compare_CatL(a, b, dat, years = c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015), ncol = 2)
compare_CatL.note_zh: 显示 4 个指定年份；省略 years 将显示全部年份。点为调查数据，线为拟合中位数。
compare_CatL.note_en: Four selected years are shown. Omit years to show all periods. Points are observations and curves fitted medians.

compare_metrics.code:
plot_compare_metrics(a, b, dat, ncol = 2) & scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 
    0.3)))
compare_metrics.note_zh: 当前数据由年龄模型生成。图示差异不能证明任一模型普遍较优；IC 还需要相同数据与似然口径。
compare_metrics.note_en: The generating model is age based. This comparison cannot establish universal superiority; information criteria also require comparable data and likelihoods.

compare_selectivity.note_zh: 当前函数展示输入 q 的连接线，不是估计的渔业选择性。两模型使用同一输入，曲线重合。
compare_selectivity.note_en: This function connects the input survey q; it does not estimate fishery selectivity. Identical inputs produce overlapping curves.

compare_F_apical.zh: 总体 F 比较 apical
compare_F_apical.code: plot_compare_annual_F(a, b, method = method) + labs(title = if (method == "apical") "Apical fishing mortality" else "Mean fishing mortality")
compare_F_apical.note_zh: apical 取最大值，mean 取组间算术平均，均非丰度加权。函数名称含 annual，但不会自动把季度率年化。
compare_F_apical.note_en: Apical is the maximum; mean is an unweighted group average. Despite its name, the function does not annualize quarterly rates.

compare_F_mean.zh: 总体 F 比较 mean
compare_F_mean.code: plot_compare_annual_F(a, b, method = method) + labs(title = if (method == "apical") "Apical fishing mortality" else "Mean fishing mortality")
compare_F_mean.note_zh: apical 取最大值，mean 取组间算术平均，均非丰度加权。函数名称含 annual，但不会自动把季度率年化。
compare_F_mean.note_en: Apical is the maximum; mean is an unweighted group average. Despite its name, the function does not annualize quarterly rates.

retro_ACL.code: plot_retro(retro_a, facet_col = 2, rho_digits = 3, rho_size = 3, point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6)

retro_ALSCL.code: plot_retro(retro_b, facet_col = 2, rho_digits = 3, rho_size = 3, point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6)

truth.code:
ggplot(estimates, aes(Year, Value, color = Model)) + geom_line() + scale_color_manual(values = setNames(acl_theme("compare_colors"), 
    c("ACL", "ALSCL"))) + geom_line(data = truth, aes(Year, Truth), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = 2) + 
    facet_wrap(~Quantity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(y = NULL)
truth.note_zh: 黑虚线为生成真值；固定生物参数，且模拟与拟合的补充过程不同。
truth.note_en: Black dashed curves are generating truth. Biology is fixed; recruitment processes differ.
